name: Headlight Production Line Solutions
summary: A complete line automation solution for automotive headlamp manufacturers, covering lens assembly, reflector installation, LED module assembly, and final packaging.
contentHtml:
The headlamp production line solution is a complete line automation solution provided by TXAM for automotive headlamp manufacturers.

Solution Components

The complete line covers the entire process including lens assembly, reflector installation, LED module assembly, light distribution testing, sealing adhesive application, air tightness testing, appearance inspection, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Precision optical assembly ensures lighting performance
  • Precise positioning of LED modules ensures accurate and consistent light patterns
  • Sealing adhesive system ensures reliable sealing performance
  • Sensitive air tightness testing ensures no leakage
  • Automated light distribution testing ensures high performance compliance rate
  • Quick changeover for multiple models adapts to market demands

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
